apps.name: McOS Browser
apps.about: Browse the whole web from McOS: YouTube, JavaScript sites, logins and web apps. The Minecraft server runs a real browser engine (Chromium) for your computer and shows it in this window, with sound. Downloads go to Downloads (an .mca opens in the App Installer). Needs MCPC mod mcpc58 or newer; on a dedicated server the owner turns the web on (-Dmcpc.web=on). Films on Netflix-style sites need a licence the engine doesn't have.
apps.whatsnew: The full web: the server now runs a real browser engine for your computer, so JavaScript sites, YouTube with sound, logins and web apps work. Typing, clicking, scrolling and copy / paste go to the page. The first time it downloads the engine (about 100 MB). Simple mode is still there if the engine can't run.

apps.name: Sticky Notes
apps.about: Quick notes in six colours. Everything saves as you type, and your notes are there next time. Search, Ctrl+N for a new note, emoji welcome.
apps.whatsnew: Adds a screenshot to its Store page.
